name: Elaine Edwards
bio: a Senator from Louisiana; born Elaine Lucille Schwartzenburg in Marksville, Avoyelles Parish, La., March 8, 1929; attended public schools; appointed on August 1, 1972, to the United States Senate by her husband, Governor Edwin W. Edwards, as a Democrat to fill the vacancy caused by the death of Allen J. Ellender, and served from August 1, 1972, until her resignation November 13, 1972; was a resident of Baton Rouge, La., until her death on May 14, 2018; interment in Resthaven Gardens of Memory and Mausoleum, Baton Rouge, La.
